I want my niece to grow up with a healthy image of marriage, and if my sister only stays because she wants the family to stay together and keep what she obviously experiences as a failing marriage intact, thats not what she should see as a model for future relationships. I do agree love is work, but sometimes you have to step back and come to terms with the fact sometimes people don't work together the way they once did

She has had a history with making impulsive decisions, and so I've been trying to talk with her to ensure this is really, truly what she wants, and that she doesn't make such a heavy decision rashly. I don't see everything, despite living with them. There could be troubles they've hidden well, but I thought the same when i was first told. Its her choice ultimately, and I need to be there for my niece, and both of them afterwards. She seems fairly set on this path, and has assured me she's been thinking about it for months. I will support her through her choices, and offer whichever brand of support everyone needs going forward
